option.viewport-modes.none.label: Letterbox
option.viewport-modes.none.hint: Keeps the game ratio and fills the rest of the window with black bars.
option.viewport-modes.fit.label: Fit Window
option.viewport-modes.fit.hint: Locks the window shape to the game ratio while you resize it, so no bars show.
option.viewport-modes.fill.label: Stretch
option.viewport-modes.fill.hint: Stretches the picture to fill the whole window.
section.window.title: Window
start-fullscreen.label: Start in Fullscreen
start-fullscreen.description: Automatically enter fullscreen when the game starts
viewport-constraint.label: Viewport
viewport-constraint.description: Controls how the game canvas relates to the window
pixel-perfect.label: Pixel Perfect
pixel-perfect.description: Scale the picture by whole source pixels only, so every pixel is exactly the same size. Removes the shimmer on fences, walls and other straight edges while scrolling, at the cost of slightly wider black borders. Turns Linear Filtering off while active.
